description: Details that can almost always be recorded for a reaction, scored by ord_schema.completeness. Advisory only: a low score never blocks a submission. Weights are per dataset profile; a weight of 0 leaves an item out under that profile. Set by experts at first, to be revised from how the ORD corpus is filled (#1068).

items.description: Every input component has a reaction role.
items.suggestion: give every input component a reaction_role

items.description: Every input component has an amount.
items.suggestion: give every input component an amount
mark the limiting reactant with is_limiting

items.description: Every input has an addition order, where there is more than one.
Every compound given as a structure also has a name.
items.suggestion: give every compound recorded as a structure a NAME identifier too

items.description: How the temperature was controlled is recorded.
How the reaction was stirred is recorded.
The reaction time of each outcome is recorded.
Every product measurement has a type.
items.suggestion: give every product measurement a type

items.description: Every product measurement names the analysis behind it, and that analysis is recorded.
items.suggestion: link every product measurement to a recorded analysis with analysis_key

items.description: Which product was desired is marked.
items.suggestion: mark the desired product with is_desired_product

items.description: The reaction cites a DOI, patent or publication URL.
items.suggestion: add a doi, patent, or publication_url to the provenance

items.description: When the record was created is recorded.
